items.name: Woodward's Twine Belt
items.lore: Oisin ties up the saplings that walk too far. He has a lot of twine.

items.name: Culraid Thatch Ring
items.lore: Plaited from a roof the walking wood tried to pull down.

items.name: Luch-Tail Bracer
items.lore: Luch tails, braided. They make a surprisingly good bracer.

items.name: Thatcher's Charm
items.lore: A knot of straw from the first roof you saved.

items.name: Lake-Road Boots-Charm
items.lore: A pebble from the lake road, worn smooth by people leaving Culraid.

items.name: Sentinel's Token
items.lore: Ceannai's token, given to those who walk the road on their own.

items.name: Miller's Flour-Sack Belt
items.lore: Tough sacking, stitched double. Eithne swears by it.

items.name: Granary-Key Ring
items.lore: The key to the mill's grain store, made into a ring.

items.name: Irusan's Claw Torc
items.lore: In the old story the cat Irusan killed Luchtigern, king of the mice. This is a claw from a cat nearly as big.

items.name: Mouse-King's Collar
items.lore: Bright metal, warm to the touch. It glows faintly at night.

items.name: Inn-Luck Harp Charm
items.lore: A tiny harp of bog-oak. The luck of a house sixty years old is in it.

items.name: Ale-Belly Girdle
items.lore: The cluricaun king's belt. Let out several times.

items.name: Luch-Rider Bracer
items.lore: Cluricauns ride the giant luch like ponies. This is from a saddle.

items.name: Cellar-Key Ring
items.lore: The key to Tadhg's cellar, made into a ring. It opens other cellars too, you suspect.

items.name: Jetty-Song Pendant
items.lore: A harp-peg on a cord. Hum the old tune and it hums back.

items.name: Lake-Watcher's Cloak
items.lore: Grey wool, for long nights on the jetty.

items.name: Toll-Taker's Ring
items.lore: The gurites charged a toll on the south road. In blood, mostly.

items.name: Road-Post Bracer
items.lore: Iron from the Sentinels' burned road post.

items.name: Ferryman's Pole-Ring
items.lore: Bog-oak and brass, from Colm's old ferry pole.

items.name: Bill-of-Sale Charm
items.lore: Kept to remember them by.

items.name: Cave-Mouth Belt
items.lore: From the ursine's trading post at the mouth of Treibh Caillte.

items.name: Unbound Wrist
items.lore: The cord that tied him, worn as a promise.

items.name: Tiomoid's Hill-Ring
items.lore: Tiomoid kept the camp's watch. He never slept.

items.name: Trefor's Toll-Bag Belt
items.lore: Trefor kept the gurites' purse. It was heavier than it looked.

items.name: Gurite-King's Crown-Ring
items.lore: Donnan's crown was a ring of gurite tolls. This was the best of them.

items.name: Mantle of the South Road
items.lore: The Sentinels' own, for the ones who took the road back.

items.name: Hill-Camp Torc
items.lore: Bronze, from the gurites' war-chest.

items.name: Amadan's Straw Crown
items.lore: A crown of straw that the amadan wore. Whoever wears it hears music nobody else can.

items.name: Verse-Book Clasp
items.lore: From Eoin's book of poems. Every page is full, and none of it makes sense, and all of it is beautiful.

items.name: Gurite Waylayer Ring
items.lore: Taken off a gurite who robbed travellers on the south road.

items.name: Alp-Luachra Hide Cloak
items.lore: The alp luachra are newts that crawl into sleepers' mouths. The hide is very good leather.

items.name: Wet-Footprint Charm
items.lore: A pebble from the shore where the touched walked in.

items.name: Druid's Rush-Belt
items.lore: Siofra plaits them for anyone who sits with the touched a night.

items.name: Siofra's Rowan Charm
items.lore: Rowan berries on red thread. The drowned won't cross it.

items.name: Lit-From-Within Bracer
items.lore: From one of the drowned. The glow went out of it when they were laid to rest.

items.name: Lhia's Mirror Pendant
items.lore: A muse's mirror. In it you look the way you'd like to.

items.name: Unsung Ring
items.lore: Silver, with no song on it at all. That's the point.

items.name: Frozen-Tear Charm
items.lore: A fairy's tear, frozen. It never melts.

items.name: Mourner's Belt
items.lore: Grey silk, from a melancholic fairy's girdle.

items.name: Grainne's Ribbon Bracer
items.lore: Grainne's hair-ribbon, wound round a bracer. She wanted you to have it.

items.name: Empty-Chair Ring
items.lore: Cut from the arm of the fairy queen's chair.

items.name: Moonstone Circlet Charm
items.lore: A stone from the crown the queen left on her chair.

items.name: Far Liath's Grey Cloak
items.lore: The grey men of the wood wear cloaks of mist. This one held.

items.name: Lament-Breaker's Torc
items.lore: Moonstone and grey silver. It's quiet. Everything near it is quiet.

items.name: Mantle of the Sorrowing Wood
items.lore: Woven by the fairies after their queen was laid to rest. It's the first thing they've made in years.

items.name: Unweeping Ring
items.lore: A melancholic fairy's ring. It used to be wet.

items.name: Silver Horseshoe Charm
items.lore: A silver horseshoe worn thin as a leaf. The Earl's horse threw it.

items.name: Barrow-Iron Bracer
items.lore: From a dullahan's saddle.

items.name: Envoy's Thorn Seal
items.lore: The Unseelie Court's seal: a crowned woman in thorns.

items.name: Moor-Walker's Boots-Charm
items.lore: From the moor, where the envoy waited.

items.name: Herald's Glass Torc
items.lore: The Glimmer's herald wore light like other men wear cloth. This is what was left.

items.name: Mantle of the Lake
items.lore: Aine's Circle's own, given to those who went out to the crannog.

items.name: Lullaby Ring
items.lore: Dara's tune is scratched inside the band.

items.name: Azure Novice's Ring
items.lore: Blue enamel on iron. 'Burn the light.'

items.name: Cleanser's Belt
items.lore: An Azure cleanser's belt, with loops for torches.

items.name: Azure Wisp-Catcher Bracer
items.lore: Blue iron, banded. The wisps can't get a grip on it.

items.name: Blue Flame Charm
items.lore: A flame that burns blue in a glass bead. Only the Azure know how.

items.name: Siofra's Thanks
items.lore: Rush and silver. 'Touched, not lost.'

items.name: Torch-Breaker's Bracer
items.lore: You broke the Azure's torch over your knee. This was its iron.
